notes.title: The Long-Awaited 4k update is here!
notes.content: [b]Sometimes, even small changes make a big impact![/b] This is why the game has been updated with[b] 3k and 4k support[/b]. All you need to do is crank the resolution setting up to the max! Now even U:SC can make your gaming PC run hot, and not just grandma's laptop. (You can still run the game on grandma's laptop, tho. I like it when games can do that.)

notes.title: Beta Testing Phase: GO!
notes.content:
[b]Beta Time![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41315987/5093393f0dfe9a7a2000483896e82c812ce93473.gif[/img]

The game's mostly finished and that means I gotta make some people play it. Like, what if I forgot to make a rock solid? Or a collectable explodes at you? We can't be havin' with that, oh no.

I want to release Unstrong:SC in December. See you then!

-Bernie
